name: Shiori
message: "Gyaruko-san... isn't here."

name: Shiori
message: "We missed her yesterday too. I guess our schedules don't match."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe we should try calling her. What do you think?"
(Call her)
(Don't call her)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Heeey, what's up~?"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, she picked up. Hello. Is now a good time? We wanted to ask you something."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, can we save that for later~? Talking on the phone drains me out. I'll swing by the convenience store once I'm done, 'kay~?"

name: Shiori
message: "Sure. How long do you think you'll take?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, dunno. Might take a while. I'll call you when I get there~"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. We'll just wander around until then."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yup yup, catch ya later~"

name: Shiori
message: "Sounds like she's busy. She'll call us when she gets back, so let's head somewhere else for now."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, you're right. She might be busy, and it's not like we need her right away either."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's come back later. Now, shall we go?"

name: Shiori
message: "Still no sign of Gyaruko-san."

name: Shiori
message: "No point waiting here. Let's get moving."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, there you are. Yo~!"

name: Shiori
message: "Hello. Sorry for calling you out here. Were you busy?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, not really? I was just doing the same stuff as you, Shiorin, wandering around hoping something would jog my memory."

name: Shiori
message: "Did you remember anything?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nope, not a thing~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So? Whaddya wanna ask?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. Um... it's about a certain incident..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, there she is."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm?"

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Heeeey~. What's up? Something wrong?"

name: Shiori
message: "We were looking for you. We have something to ask."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Me? Okay, shoot."

name: Shiori
message: "We're investigating a certain incident right now."

name: Shiori
message: "Have you heard of the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Pre... huh? That's a mouthful... cereal what now?"

name: Shiori
message: "Preschool girl, serial, kidnapping, and murder case."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Preschool girl, as in, little girls?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yup, that's right. Five little girls were kidnapped and killed."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whoa, scary. The heck? Did that happen around here?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm not sure if it was *right* around here, but it definitely happened in this town."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, crap, that came out wrong. I must've sounded like some heartless jerk who doesn't care."

name: Shiori
message: "So you haven't heard of it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nope, not at all. Kinda asking the wrong person, don'tcha think? I don't even have any memories."

name: Shiori
message: "Then... have you seen a little girl around here? A ghost, of course."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, that I *might* know about... I think? Hmmmm... A little girl..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, and is she one of the victims?"

name: Shiori
message: "We don't know. Maybe she is, maybe she isn't."

name: Shiori
message: "We only saw her once, but ever since then she's been stuck in my mind. That's why we've been looking for her."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm... a little girl... a little ghost girl..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm~... Nah, I don't think so... I don't really see ghost kids that much..."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... Thanks anyway."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I'll call ya if I spot one somewhere~"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, please. Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "As thanks, we'll share what we found from our investigation. It's not much, though."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anything's cool with me. More info's always welcome~"

name: Shiori
message: "We found the name of the high school girl who jumped from the apartment building."

name: Shiori
message: "Her name was Kirishiki Nagisa."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh...? That's... a different reaction than usual. Did you know her?"

name: Shiori
message: "Gyaruko-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "You okay?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I remember now..."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "My memories just went whoooooosh! And BAM—they're back! Whoa, this feels crazy! I, like, remembered a ton just now!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She's me!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "*I'm* Kirishima Nagisa!"

name: Shiori
message: "No way... what a coincidence... I was hoping you might know her, but I never imagined you were *actually* her."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yup, she's me alright! Riiiight! I fell and died!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ugh, this sucks. I can't believe I died like that. What was I even doing, sitting there?"

name: Shiori
message: "From the way you worded it... it wasn't suicide, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, it wasn't."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well~, I'm already dead... so it's not like anyone's gonna arrest me, yeah? So I'll just come clean..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I was, uh, having a just teeeeny bit of alcohol."

name: Shiori
message: "You got drunk and fell...?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, that. So, like, I'd sit on the railing, legs swinging, chugging my drink. That was kinda my thing."

name: Shiori
message: "And you lost your balance and fell..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Pretty sure I died from that. Probably instantly. I don't remember the moment I hit the ground, like, at all."

name: Shiori
message: "I never thought the first death we looked into would end up being yours."

name: Shiori
message: "I tried jumping off the roof myself... and it was terrifying. The ground just rushes up at you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah... No clue. I only remember the 'oh, I'm falling' part."

name: Shiori
message: "Want to see?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? See what?"

name: Shiori
message: "The photo of when I fell to my death."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hah?"

name: Shiori
message: "Well? Are you curious? My buddy took it for me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What? No! What is wrong with you?! Why would you show me something so gross? Heck, why would you even take a photo of that?!"
(Take out your smartphone)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, I said no! Get that thing outta my face! It's already giving me the creeps!"

name: Shiori
message: "Eheh, sorry. We got carried away."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm glad you got your memory back. Congratulations."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep, thanks, thanks."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, and something else came back too. That, uh, whatchamacallit-case you mentioned."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, really?"

name: Shiori
message: "You remembered that much all at once?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Like I said, my memories just went whoooooosh!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I mean, if you think about it, forgetting your own name's kinda bad, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How do I put it? It was like, my missing name was holding my memories back, and when I broke through that—BAM! Everything came flooding out."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Something like that."

name: Shiori
message: "I see, so you were like, 'whoooooosh,' then 'BAM!'"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep yep, more or less."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, back to the topic."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I think I might know who the culprit is."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe, yeah. I always saw this sketchy old guy at the park, grinning at the kids."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Even when I was alive, people were like, 'Hey, that creep's probably the culprit, right?'"

name: Shiori
message: "Is he still in this town?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, but no."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "He's dead, like us."

name: Shiori
message: "So he's a ghost now... I wonder what happened?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Dunno. But the fact he's doing the same thing even after dying is kinda hilarious. Still staring at kids and grinning. Gross."

name: Shiori
message: "...So the suspect died, and the case just stayed unsolved? Is that why there were no reports about how it ended?"

name: Shiori
message: "So, which park is he at?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? Are you gonna go see him?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes... If possible, I'd like to talk to him."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yikes. I mean, I won't stop you, though."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "He kinda pops up at random parks, but the one he's at most is over... hmm..."
(Launch the Maps app)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, nice, good thinking."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Let's see~... hm? Where was it again? We're here now, so..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, here. This park, the one with the swings. This is where I see him a lot."

name: Shiori
message: "This place...? He wasn't there yesterday."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well, he is kinda random. Try going there at night. You'll have a better chance of running into him."

name: Shiori
message: "Night? Got it... Thank you."
"Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're welcome~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, uh... you're actually going out of your way to meet a serial killer? You're kinda nuts, y'know that?"

name: Shiori
message: "It seems I'm not just fixated on dying, but also on the cases themselves."

name: Shiori
message: "We don't know if he's really the culprit, and if we can speak with him, we might learn something."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. What does he look like? Any distinguishing features?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Features? Uh... I've never really looked that closely, but..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How should I put it... some old guy? Yeah, some old dude with sharp eyes."

name: Shiori
message: "A sharp-gazed older man... Got it. Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Did you really get it? Whatever, I guess."

name: Shiori
message: "There's still some time before evening."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, right. I should put together my Death Diary entry while I can."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Death... Diary? Actually, never mind. I think I get it."

name: Shiori
message: "Want to see?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I said no. Keep it to yourself!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, okay~. Anyway, it's time to print the photo. If you would."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, there it is."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Why are you even doing all that?"

name: Shiori
message: "So I can stay as I am... I guess."

name: Shiori
message: "I've already lost the 'me' I used to be. But if I keep writing down what I remember, I can at least preserve who I am right now."

name: Shiori
message: "You could call it a measure to keep my memory loss in check."

name: Shiori
message: "Ms. Librarian gave us the hint, and my buddy gave it to me as a present."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm... Hope you remember everything soon, Shiorin."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I hope so too... Ah."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? What?"

name: Shiori
message: "Should I start calling you Nagisa-san now?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, huh... Nah, just Gyaruko like always. I've gotten used to it."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, I understand. Well then, Gyaruko-san, it's about time we left. Thank you for everything."
"Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep yep, see ya~"

name: Shiori
message: "Now then... We still have some time before evening."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we kill some time somewhere, or just wait at the park?"

name: Shiori
message: "If there's still anything you need to do, we should handle it before heading to the park."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? You're back. What is it?"
(Ask about Gyaruko-san)
(Ask about the incident)
(Ask about the culprit)
(Thank her and leave)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Believe it or not, I'm actually from a good family."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Don'tcha think Nagisa sounds all elegant and stuff? No? ...Yeah, guess not."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But I kinda snapped and bounced to the opposite extreme."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But really though, why bother asking about me? I got nothing. I'm just your everyday gal."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Uh, you're asking the wrong gal... I mean, must've been rough, I guess?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I mean, yeah, I kinda wonder about myself as a person sometimes. But if I'm not into something, I just can't bring myself to care."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Dunno, ask that weird dude. If he really is the culprit, you'll probably get way more out of him than me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe? Yeah, maybe. He's just, like, the likeliest suspect, that's all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But you'll get it when you see him. He seriously looks like he'd do something like that."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How do I put it... his smile? His eyes? The way he stares at kids, it's bad, man. Gives you chills."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, of course people were like, 'Yeah, he's gotta be the culprit.'"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Just go and see for yourself. You'll get what I mean, seriously."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you, Gyaruko-san. See you again."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep yep, g'luck~"
